headline: CHOOSE HOW YOU WANT TO JOIN bandiTour
supporting: One person or business can play more than one role. Choose what describes you now — you can add additional roles later.

cards.title: Hotel / Hotelier
cards.explanation: Hotels, boutique hotels, aparthotels, and hospitality properties.
cards.combinesWith: Add hotel experiences later — same hotel, no second company.

cards.title: Local Bandit
cards.explanation: Verified destination insiders and local voices — not simply an experience provider.
cards.cta: I want to become a Local Bandit
cards.combinesWith: Can also be a Creator / Content Partner or Local Experience — one partner_id.
cards.never: Octopus Verified™ is never shown before explicit approval. Candidate ≠ Verified.

cards.title: Local Experience
cards.explanation: Bookable local experiences: food walks, workshops, photography, classes, guided activities.
cards.combinesWith: Not automatically a Local Bandit. You may add that role later.
cards.never: Does not grant Local Bandit or Octopus Verified™.

cards.title: Travel in a Bottle host
cards.explanation: Bookable sleeping experiences: treehouses, cabins, farm and nature stays.
cards.cta: I offer a place to stay
cards.combinesWith: May also offer a Local Experience — same host, two roles.
cards.never: Not a hotel operator and not a Local Bandit.

cards.title: SmartTraveler business
cards.explanation: The verified local business network — restaurants, cafés, shops, wellness, venues. Not a coupon page.
cards.combinesWith: May also sell on bandiShop — one business, two roles.

cards.title: Sell on bandiShop
cards.explanation: Independent local products: design, fashion, craft, books, art, objects — with a real pickup location for Near me discovery.
cards.combinesWith: Often paired with SmartTraveler business — never a duplicate record.
cards.never: Not a hotel and not a destination organization.

cards.title: Destination partner
cards.explanation: Municipalities, tourism boards, and city or regional destination organizations.
cards.combinesWith: Sees Local Bandits, Experiences, and SmartTraveler as an ecosystem — not as those roles.

cards.title: Creator / Content Partner
cards.explanation: High-value travel storytelling, hotel coverage, destination stories, and branded editorial collaborations.
cards.combinesWith: May coexist with Local Bandit on the same partner_id.
cards.never: Not called an influencer. Not automatically a Local Bandit.

cards.title: Affiliate / service partner
cards.explanation: Operational traveler services: transfers, drivers, ticketing, mobility, concierge fulfillment.
cards.combinesWith: Restricted to operational travel services — not a catch-all.
cards.never: Not a creator role and not a Local Bandit.

hotelExperienceOffer.note: Hotel Experience / Offer is a Hotelier sub-role — create offers inside Hotelier OS; not a public Choose Your Business category.
